//: Story Phase 5: the Grand Stenchmaster and Squawks between scenes (selectors in data/npcs/phase5_crew.json).
garrick.p5_s1_1: garrick[smug]: Good morning, Captain. Don't mind me. I'm at my post.
garrick[businesslike]: The post is a chair.
garrick.p5_s1_2: garrick[businesslike]: Shh. It's nearly warmed up.
garrick[smug]: All in good time, Captain. All in good time.
garrick.p5_s2: garrick[businesslike]: The Center passed right through my station, Captain. I didn't feel a thing. I think it likes me.
garrick[proud]: Then it has excellent taste.
garrick.p5_ses_hint: garrick[proud]: Go on, Captain. Have a look. Big knob for the channels. Little knob for... well. Don't touch the little knob.
garrick.p5_s4_1: garrick[proud]: Welcome to the office, Captain. Mind the cable. Mind the other cable. Mind that one especially, it bites.
garrick.p5_s4_2: garrick[businesslike]: I've had complaints, I hear. Leave them in the box.
garrick.p5_qa_2: garrick[businesslike]: Second sip. Notes of... bilge. Tar. A hint of Tuesday.
garrick.p5_s6_1: garrick[proud]: Do you like the suit, Captain? Be honest.
garrick[happy]: That's honesty. I respect that. I'm keeping the suit.
garrick.p5_s6_2: garrick[smug]: I find people look at me differently in the suit, Captain.
captain: They look at you the same way. Just for longer.
garrick.p5_s7: garrick[businesslike]: Everything at once, Captain! What a day for the office!
garrick[smug]: And let the seat go cold? In THIS emergency?
garrick.p5_s8: garrick[businesslike]: I've done my one, Captain. You saw. Everybody saw. I'd like it in the log.
garrick.p5_s9_1: garrick[businesslike]: Evening programming, Captain. It's mostly static. Some of the best static I've seen.

then: On the S.E.S., something grey goes round and round. It might be the fish.

garrick.p5_s9_2: garrick[proud]: One useful thing per emergency, Captain. I've been thinking about it. I'm going to save mine for the really big ones.
garrick[businesslike]: Then I'll have to be selective.
garrick.p5_s9_3: garrick[proud]: Would you like to hear about the medals again, Captain?

then.caption: Each one presented by the Grand Stenchmaster to the Grand Stenchmaster.

then: garrick[delighted]: I'm thinking of a sixth. For services to the rule.
garrick[proud]: And it was very well done.
garrick[offended]: Your loss, Captain. They're very shiny.

garrick.p5_s9_4: garrick[businesslike]: Every Grand Stenchmaster must wear the suit with pride, Captain.
garrick[smug]: Then I'm setting a very high standard.
He turns back to the screen.
squawks.p5_s1: squawks[insulting]: Captain's in the way of it.
squawks.p5_s2_1: squawks[insulting]: Just saying it. In case anyone forgot.
squawks.p5_s2_2: squawks[insulting]: Worried is looking. Looking is rude.
squawks.p5_s4: squawks[exhausted]: Still hear the bell. Even when it isn't ringing.
squawks.p5_s5: squawks[smug]: Fat one's sewing. Squawks can hear it.
squawks[insulting]: Nothing good gets sewn quiet.
squawks.p5_s6: squawks[furious]: Squawks never got a bottle cap.
squawks.p5_s8: squawks[exhausted]: Everything. Squawks is confirming everything today. Saves time.
squawks.p5_s9_2: squawks[exhausted]: Squawks will sleep in it anyway.
squawks.p5_s9_3: captain: I know. Go to sleep.
squawks[insulting]: Captain tell television to go to sleep.
